title: feat(studio): remove the Studio home; /studio opens the last package or Setup > Packages
body:
Fixes #36908
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员和开发者打开 Studio 不再看到软件包卡片页：有上次用过的软件包就直接进它；没有的话，能打开设置软件包列表的人进那个列表，打不开的开发者进「全部元数据」；已安装应用「改了什么」挪到了设置里的软件包详情；「添加应用」菜单去掉了「用 AI 搭建」，「在 Studio 中新建」改名为「新建空白应用」并且总是出现。
- 这是 Studio 重构专题的「去掉 Studio 首页」一步：首页的入口大多已有去处，但软件包的「管理」和「全部软件包」要等 Studio 顶栏菜单那张卡（#37139）补上，一步「新建应用」要等新建软件包对话框那张卡（#37134）；另有三个入口没能在真实环境走过，只有自动测试覆盖。
- 如果出错，用户进 Studio 会落到软件包列表或「全部元数据」页，而不是首页；这次只改界面，不改数据，可以直接撤回。
- 本 PR 超过 3000 行（主要是删除旧首页和它的测试），请您按大 PR 流程审核后再合并。

## What changes

Epic #36890 decision 9: the package-card page at bare `/studio` (`BuilderLanding`) is removed. This PR finds a new home for every entry it carried and deletes the page, the code only it used, and its tests.

Every Studio exit that names no package now makes one choice, `studioEntryFallbackPath`: Setup → Packages (`/apps/setup/component/developer/packages?face=admin`) for a principal holding `setup.access` and `manage_platform_settings`, and `/studio/~all/metadata` (the All metadata area) for one who may enter Studio but not that page. The capability set is the one Studio's entry gate read: app-shell now exports `StudioEntryPermissionsProvider` and `useStudioEntryPermissions`, and the console's `RequireStudioAccess` provides the set around the `/studio` subtree. Outside that provider the set reads as holding nothing, so nobody is sent to a page they may not open.

| Entry the home carried | Where it goes now |
|:---|:---|
| bare `/studio` | `StudioEntryRedirect` (in the lazy Studio chunk). It opens the newest remembered package (the recent `package` entries `StudioRoute` records) that `GET /api/v1/packages` still lists, else `studioEntryFallbackPath`. If the list cannot be read, it opens the newest remembered package, and Studio reports the failed read itself. |
| New package (`/studio?new=package`) | `SETUP_NEW_PACKAGE_PATH`: the admin face with `?new=package`. It opens New Package on arrival and drops the param with a replace. After create it lands in Studio on the new package (#36834). Callers: Home's no-agent chip, the `/ai` no-assistant screen, the 「Add app」 menu and the no-apps screen, all labelled 「New blank app」 / 「新建空白应用」 now (below). An old `/studio?new=package` bookmark goes there for a holder of the pair, and to the All metadata area for anyone else (`studioNewPackageEntryPath`). One-step 新建应用 is #37134. |
| `~all` / `~org` cards | Already in the left menu (#36899). Nothing more to do here. |
| Per-app "n customized, m switched off" and the "Customizations in this environment" panel | `PackageCustomizationsPanel`, shown in a read-only base's detail sheet on the admin face. It is not shown for an authored package, a `.custom` pair or a kernel package. It has a summary line, rows with tabs (adds Layouts), search, Show all, and 「Customize in Studio」. **"Customized" now counts `counts.arrangements`.** This delivers #36833's requirement in the panel's new home; #36833 was closed as not planned (ruling 7125820739), so this PR does not close it. |
| Card Manage and the All packages link (development face) | Not this card: the door is added by #37139 (card note 7146329913). The development face stays reachable by its address. |
| Recently viewed | Now Studio's entry itself: `/studio` opens the newest remembered package. |
| 「包不存在」 → Studio home | The button follows `studioEntryFallbackPath`: 「Open the package list」 → Setup → Packages for a holder (`engine.studio.notFound.packageList`), 「Open All metadata」 → the All metadata area otherwise (new key `engine.studio.notFound.allMetadata`). |
| `AppContent` fallbacks, `packagedActionsStudioPath` fallback with no package named | `SETUP_PACKAGES_PATH`. |
| `studio:builder` (the `@objectstack/studio` app's 「应用构建」) | Forwards to `/studio`. |
| 「Add app」 (sidebar app menu, and the no-apps screen's buttons) | Maintainer rulings 7153161067 and 7153400210 on #36908: 「Build with AI」 (to bare `/studio`) is removed, and `new-in-studio` is pushed for every admitted viewer on a deployment that offers metadata authoring, whether or not the build agent is served. It is relabelled under its existing key `home.build.inStudio`: en "New blank app", zh-Hans 「新建空白应用」, zh-Hant regenerated (「新建空白應用」), and the eight other packs translated anew, as `check:i18n-drift` requires of an en change. Home's no-agent chip and the `/ai` button read the same key; their inline `defaultValue` now matches the en value (`check:i18n-keys`); the chip's condition and target are unchanged. It stays inside `isAiStudioEnabled()`, because with `features.aiStudio` false the runtime offers no metadata authoring; a viewer `useMayAddApp` admits there gets the marketplace's two entries, so the list is never empty for an admitted viewer. `SidebarAppMenu` reads the list itself and draws neither 「Add app」 nor its separator for an empty list. Home's 「Build an app」 chip and Home's 「Build with AI」 drawer button are untouched. |

Removed: `BuilderLanding.tsx`, its `BuilderLanding.*` test files, `fetchInstalledPackageRow` (only the home's Manage called it) with its pin, and the home's console frame in `StudioRoute` (header and command palette). Two deleted suites still pinned code that stays, and those halves moved (see Tests): the permission matrix's read-only hint copy, and the three new-app door cases. `LandingCustomizationsPanel` and `landingCustomizations-io` were renamed and rewritten as `PackageCustomizationsPanel` and `packageCustomizationRows`. `newAppDoor.ts`, `PackageFormDialog`'s `newApp` branch and the `engine.studio.newApp.*` strings stay for #37134; the branch keeps its three cases, now mounted on `PackageFormDialog` itself.

**Strings.** The home's `engine.studio.landing.*` keys and `engine.studio.landingHome` that ship in the released `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` (71 in each of `en` and `zh`, measured against the published tarball; 3 of them are still read by the Packages page) stay, the other 68 no longer read. Removing a published key is a narrowing, so this PR removes none. The four landing keys added after 18.6.0 and never released (`manage`, `manageTitle`, `allPackages`, `allPackagesTitle`) are removed. `engine.packages.customizations.*`, `engine.studio.notFound.packageList` and `engine.studio.notFound.allMetadata` are added (38 keys per language). The PR changes no existing value.

**Changesets.** `36908-remove-studio-home.md` (app-shell, console, platform-objects) says what users see, in their words. The i18n note is in its own `@object-ui/i18n`-only changeset, `36908-studio-home-strings.md`. Both carry the two declaration lines.

Checklist: `studio-authoring.package-customization-counts-and-marks` (rev 4) and `studio-authoring.org-scope-flows` (rev 5) are re-pointed. The rev 4 note now says #36833 was closed as not planned and this card delivers its requirement.

Size at `64e7071b`: +2,093 / −5,189 across 98 files rename-aware (+2,465 / −5,561 across 100 without renames), mostly deletions. Per ruling 7145880574 on #36890 this lands as one PR, reviewed by the maintainer after L1.

**Overlaps** (overlap-check at `64e7071b`, against `origin/main` `d62f9e9c`): origin/main merges cleanly. This round merged main three times; resolved here:
- #37089 (landed as `886e9707`): conflicted in `StudioDesignSurface.notFound-26708`; both sides added the same `@object-ui/plugin-detail` import, main's comment kept. The same merge brought #37198's address-guard fixtures spelling the removed `STUDIO_LANDING_PATH`; they are dropped here.
- #37185 (landed as `ad604c10`): `PackageSwitcher.tsx` keeps this branch's side (`fetchInstalledPackageRow` and `STUDIO_LANDING_PATH`, which #37185 moved onto the authenticated fetch, are deleted here); its edits to the six test files this branch deletes were stub adaptations (a `headers` field, a module-top import, the gate's fetch double) with no subject left to pin. The new customizations read goes through `packageCustomizations-io.ts`, already on the authenticated fetch; `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`'s stub now carries `headers: new Headers()`.
- #37204 (landed as `bd98dd12`): `StudioRoute.test.tsx` and `StudioRoute.lazyBuilder-11798` keep this branch's removal of the home-frame cases; `StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561` keeps this branch's comment line and #37204's `app-bar-product-home` test-id absence, without the old-name check.

Still open; whichever lands second merges main and resolves:
- #37249 (#37227) conflicts in `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732`. Beyond the text: its first case expects the no-apps doors `[template, marketplace]` with the build agent served, and 「New blank app」 now shows there too (ruling 7153400210), so the second lander keeps `new-in-studio` first. Its HomePage filter of `build-with-ai` becomes a no-op. It touches neither `home.build.inStudio`'s values nor the chip's lines (measured by `git merge-tree` against its branch).
- #37241 conflicts in `SidebarAppMenu.tsx` (it extracts the app list into `AppMenuList`; this branch gates 「Add app」 on a non-empty list).
- #37168 conflicts in `BuilderLanding.*` test files this branch deletes, the not-found pin, and `PackageFormDialog.newAppStep-36748` (git reads it as the rename of `BuilderLanding.newAppDoor-36748`, which #37168 edits: a module-top `@object-ui/plugin-detail` import, already here, and a `/studio/:packageId/metadata/*` route the second lander carries over). Separately, #37168 changes `switchedOffActionPath` to `/metadata/object/OBJECT?action=NAME`, so `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx:188` (`/data?surface=object%3A…&action=…`) goes red once both land, though the textual merge is clean. Whichever lands second updates line 188.
- #37169 conflicts in `BuilderLanding.orgScope-11553` and the not-found pin; the second lander re-runs the 18.6.0 key comparison.
- #37226, #37215 and #37210 merge cleanly.

### Read first

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioEntryRedirect.tsx`: the whole `/studio` decision, and the two capability helpers. Risk: where a non-administrator lands (the `studioEntryFallbackPath` pair), now for the bookmark too.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageCustomizationsPanel.tsx` and the mount in `PackagesPage.tsx` (`PackageDetailSheet`). Risk: the gate `!authoring && !writable && !isKernel && !isCustomizationPackage(id)`.
3. `ui/apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx` with `studioEntryPermissions.ts`: the index route and the capability set the entry gate provides to Studio (`StudioEntryPermissionsProvider`), which the not-found exit reads.

### Two-minute verification

As the seeded admin with nothing remembered, open `/_console/studio`. Expected: you land on Setup → Packages (`…/developer/packages?face=admin`). Open the ObjectStack Showcase row: its detail shows "Customizations in this environment" with a Customize in Studio link.

## Tests

New pins:
- `StudioEntryRedirect.test.tsx` (11 cases): the newest remembered package the list still names opens; a package the list no longer names is skipped; nothing remembered leads to Setup → Packages, read without a list request; a Studio-only principal lands on `~all`; a failed list read opens the newest remembered package; the old new-package bookmark is forwarded for an administrator (CONTROL) and sends a Studio-only principal to `~all`, never to Setup; both helpers read the same capability pair.
- `StudioDesignSurface.notFound-26708`: the not-found button opens Setup → Packages for an administrator (CONTROL), and for a Studio-only principal it reads 「Open All metadata」 and opens `~all`, never Setup. The harness provides the entry gate's set through `StudioEntryPermissionsProvider`.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.readOnlyHintCopy-12171.test.ts`: the half of the deleted `BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171` that covered `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint`, which `PermissionMatrixEditor` still draws. No table names the organization axis; lit control that it names the environment overlay in every table; lit control that `t()` serves the value the extractor read, for every declared locale.
- `PackageFormDialog.newAppStep-36748.test.tsx`: the three `BuilderLanding.newAppDoor-36748` cases, moved onto `PackageFormDialog` with `newApp={newAppStep(client, locale)}`, mounted as the home mounted it (create mode, Studio on the new package after save): the dialog worded for an app in zh; package POST, app draft, app publish, then the Studio header names the app and 「‹ Back to app」 opens it; a taken app name refuses the confirm and writes nothing.
- `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`: the rows and counts, including the **#36833 arrangement-only case**; the empty and failed states (never "0"); row and switched-off-action links; tabs, search and Show all; zh words; and the moved rows and labels io.
- In the `PackagesPage` administration-face harness, two describes: "the new-package deep link" (3 cases) and "a read-only base's customizations in its detail" (6 cases: a code package draws the section with arrangements counted; an authored package does not; the development face does not; a read-only `.custom` pair draws none and sends no customizations request; a kernel package's detail, opened directly because the admin face lists none, draws none and sends no request; CONTROL, the same direct render of a code package draws it and reads once).
- `SidebarAppMenu-36112` (the shared harness, new top-level describe): with build and ask, the legacy build id, ask only, other agents only, or no agent served, 「Add app」 offers `new-in-studio` ("New blank app", to New Package), the template and the marketplace, and never 「Build with AI」; never empty for an admitted viewer with authoring but no marketplace, or a marketplace but no authoring; CONTROL, with neither the viewer is not admitted; guard, an admitted viewer handed no entries gets no 「Add app」 and no separator. `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732`: the no-apps doors are `[new-in-studio, template, marketplace]` with the build agent served.
- Converted, not deleted: the StudioRoute gate, lazy-module, recent-visit and access-notice pins; `studio:builder` registration (now a forward); `setupMetadataRedirect`; `studioAddress` and its guard (the guard no longer names the deleted `STUDIO_LANDING_PATH`); the Home, sidebar 「Add app」 and `/ai` deep-link hrefs; the vocabulary census; `consoleTopBar.height-12639`; `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`.

## Acceptance notes

- The environment-wide list the home drew across all installed apps (one list, a total, grouped by app) is now shown per app only, in each read-only base's detail in Setup → Packages.
- "Customized" now has two meanings. The Setup detail counts tab, field-group and action-layout arrangements with overrides and extensions; the All metadata header still draws `customizationTotal` (overrides + extensions, `customizationMarks.ts:96-97`, drawn at `DirectoryPage.tsx:246-249`), and the same total gates the list filters in `ResourceListPage` and `useListOrderedNames`. Not aligned here: adding arrangements to that total would stop the header equalling the sum of its per-type tiles and change which lists offer the customized filter. Left for a follow-up card (raised to the seat).
- The new-package doors (Home's no-agent chip, the `/ai` screen, the 「Add app」 menu and the no-apps screen) still link straight to Setup's New Package. They are drawn only for a session that may author metadata (`manage_metadata`; the `/ai` and 「Add app」 doors also for a workspace admin only), which is not the Setup pair; a holder of those without `setup.access` and `manage_platform_settings` would reach Setup's access-denied page. Declared, not changed here (raised to the seat).
- Two console test files pinned only the home's frame and are deleted: `StudioRoute.landingI18n.test.tsx` (its header crumb) and `StudioRoute.searchPalette-11863.test.tsx` (⌘K on the home; ⌘K inside Studio is #36900). The other StudioRoute pins now stub the entry.
- Duplicate pins named for deleted tests (AGENTS.md, ruling 6120820653): the new-package deep link is pinned in the `PackagesPage` admin harness; the customization counts, rows and labels in `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`; the org-scope entry by `StudioDesignSurface.packageLessFlows-11553` and the menu pins from #36899; the permission hint copy and the new-app step moved, above. The home's own layout, ordering, Duplicate form, recent cards and Manage pins have no remaining surface to pin.
- Possibly orphaned now that the frame is gone, not removed here: `AppHeader` `variant="studio"` and `CommandPalette` `scope="studio"` (#36900 may reuse the scope).
- 「Build with AI」 is gone from the 「Add app」 menu and the no-apps screen (ruling 7153161067). Home's 「Build an app」 chip still targets bare `/studio`, and Home's own 「Build with AI」 drawer button is untouched; #37227 / #37249 removes both from Home.
- The kept-unread released studio keys stay as they are this round (the seat made dropping them optional under the 19.0.0 ruling); `home.buildWithAI` is still read by Home and is untouched.
- Recents are read local-first, and the server copy arrives after first render (`RecentItemsProvider`). On a device with no local copy, `/studio` falls back before that copy arrives; "opens the package you were last in" holds on a device that already has it.
- The 68 published landing keys are kept and unread. `check-i18n-dead-keys` (report-only, not in CI) will list them as candidates, and a later change can decide to retire them.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` still names `BuilderLanding` in a dated follow-up entry; it is a log and was left as written.
